resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on a mandatory biometric update because the only face matches from a different parent Aadhaar were adjudicated false positives, with no true duplicate or anomalous face match among them.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a first-time biometric update, which is de-duplicated like a fresh enrolment. Every face match against another parent was discounted as a false positive, so the packet was held up by matches carrying no real duplicate identity. Once those false-positive candidates are settled the packet can be replayed without resident involvement.
